name: Goose
description: Block's open-source on-machine AI agent: runs shell, reads/writes files, and uses MCP extensions to complete engineering tasks.
command: export HOME=/tmp GOOSE_PROVIDER=openai GOOSE_MODEL=gpt-4o-mini GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING=1 && printf '%s\n' "$SMADP_AGENT_TASK" > /tmp/task.txt && cd /work && exec goose run -i /tmp/task.txt
notes: Real upstream image (ghcr.io/block/goose). Runs headless via `goose run -i`; OpenAI provider configured via env (GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING avoids the OS keyring inside the container). Task is delivered through SMADP_AGENT_TASK and goose acts on the mounted /work directory.
